title: Automated Cost-Tuner: Batching & Cache Recommendations with Canary Apply and Quality-Gated Rollback
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Goal: Build an automated subsystem that generates per-route batching and KV-cache configuration recommendations, applies those recommendations safely via canary rollouts, and uses automated quality gates (eval suites + golden prompts + numeric thresholds) to decide whether to complete rollout or trigger automatic rollback. Motivation: We can reduce per-token cost by aggressive batching and cache TTL tuning, but changes risk subtle quality regressions. This ticket pairs the optimizer with an evaluations pipeline so cost improvements are enforceable and reversible without manual intervention.

Scope:
- Recommender: offline analysis job that produces deterministic candidate configs for batching and cache (batch size, max latency budget, prefix cache TTL heuristics) per customer route and model family.
- Safe apply: orchestration to perform staged canary applies (e.g., 5% -> 20% -> 100%) with rollback hooks.
- Quality gates: run an eval suite during canaries including golden prompt checks, response-similarity thresholds (embedding cosine / token overlap), task-specific metrics, and a small human-review flag.
- Rollback automation: if any gate exceeds its tolerance, automatically revert config and emit incident note and audit trail.

Out of scope: continuous model retraining or altering model weights, enterprise-only rollout flows (handled separately by Private team).
acceptance_criteria: Recommender produces deterministic configurations and an explainability summary for each candidate (why suggested)
Canary apply orchestration supports percent-based routing and automatic rollback triggers
Eval suite runs in under 90s during a canary window and returns pass/fail per route
Golden prompt checks include at least 20 prompts per route and a defined similarity metric (embedding cosine) and failure threshold
Automatic rollback reverts configs and logs a human-readable reason to Console and Audit logs
Metrics available in Console: estimated cost delta, measured latency change, and quality delta per route for each canary step
test_plan: Unit tests for recommender heuristics and explainability text
Integration test: end-to-end canary apply on staging routes with synthetic traffic and injected regressions
Eval-run tests: create synthetic golden prompts and assert the similarity metric triggers rollback when appropriate
Chaos test: simulate delayed eval responses and confirm canary timeout and safe rollback path
Manual review: PM + Quality engineer sample results from two customer routes before GA
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): Build offline recommender job and schema for candidate configs. Store candidates in ConfigStore with metadata and score.
Phase 2 (2 weeks): Implement canary apply orchestration wiring into routing layer and a simple webhook that launches eval sets when canary is promoted.
Phase 3 (1 week): Implement eval runner for golden prompts and embedding-similarity checks; integrate with Console UI for gate status.
Phase 4 (1 week): Auto-rollback implementation, audit logging, and notification hooks (Slack/Email/Console).
Phase 5 (1 week): Staging validation, performance tuning of eval suite, and documentation for SRE/Support runbooks.
